pairing: content-fold matched (note, addendum 2, C1): per seed, family member and identity, the reference and the candidate are averaged over the same content folds, those admitted on both sides; complete = all content folds in which both records hold the identity; partial = some dropped (kept, counted, listed privately); missing = none kept (listed privately, never filled)
